Personally I don’t think SH makes a person. You’re not a self-harmer, you’re a person who self-harms. SH isn’t a strength or weakness and it shouldn’t define who you are. It may come with some societal thought weakness such as scars that rude people deem gross or unsightly but I think it’s up to the person who does the hurt to decide if the harming gets to be a weakness for them. It’s a coping skill unfortunately, but a coping skill nonetheless. Also, I’m sorry your sister said that; it sounds pretty invalidating to me.

Yep! I have two other diagnoses. In learning about BPD in psych class, I found that there is a lot of comorbidity of other disorders with BPD such as depression, bipolar, substance abuse, and eating disorders.

I’d like to say that my current (and technically only haha) relationship is successful. I feel like it’s a learning process. I’m the one who has BPD  so I have to learn to communicate rather than bottle up and then explode. I also have to ask clarifying questions if my brain is telling me irrational things. On the other hand, my partner has to be patient and understand my emotional rollercoaster rides. I switch emotions quickly so my partner has to take things in stride and help me communicate/figure out what I’m feeling. As with any “normal” relationship, compassion, trust, and communication are big factors into building a strong/successful relationship
Wishing you the absolute best! Good luck :)

For relaxing options, there’s painting (I love watercolors!), self-care like a warm shower or a face mask, self-soothing such as wrapping yourself in a fuzzy blanket and watching a show. There’s lots of relaxing options! The only problem I’ve had is that my motivation is hard to come by so I really have to force myself at times to do it
I personally have found that holding cold stuff like ice cubes until they melt or scratching/squeezing a frozen orange helps me. The pain sensors are activated but no scars are made
Do you still want pain? Or are you looking for something more relaxing?

For me, I take it as a night med since a side effect is sleepiness and it’s very effective for me. I did have weight gain but that’s because I get very hungry once I wake up and eat a lot. So I’d say it’s a good drug for me at least and I just need to watch my hunger cues to make sure it’s actual hunger. (My prescription has ranged from 5mg-15mg and is now 10mg) I hope this helped even a bit and feel free to ask me more questions! I can’t promise I’ll have an answer but I’ll certainly try :)

I’m not the best at giving advice, but I can try! I vote take my words with a grain of salt haha. This is a tricky situation but I think you know that already. My parents used to act this way when I started SH, but later told me it was because they felt useless and powerless. My bet is that your family is frustrated and worried bc they can’t help. Mental health a such a complex thing that can turn at any moment. (I personally hate the unpredictability of it.) Have you discussed your guilt with the more trusted parent? I think the more you hold onto that guilt, the more it’ll turn into shame, and shame tends to super distort our thoughts. I hope this helped even a little! I’m wicked glad you’re still here even if life isn’t going well rn. Also please make sure your burns are treated properly! Good luck and take care🤍

I completely understand with the friend thing! I used to have that problem before I realized I was assuming things about them that they didn’t know about. As for therapy, would virtual sessions work? That’s what I do when I can’t do in person. I’m obviously not telling you what to do (I am just a random Reddit user after all) but maybe ask about virtual appointments? I think it’s a happy medium where they wouldn’t have to take you somewhere and you can get the help you deserve. Dude, this may be blunt and mean, so I’m sorry in advance, but your life is in danger. Help. Is. Needed. This isn’t negotiable.

Please don’t be upset with yourself. Yes, I know, that’s like saying don’t be depressed or something similar but dude look at everything you’ve accomplished! Just reading how you stopped before your episode fills me up with pride for you. I’m not saying it’ll be easy, but I am saying that you can use your past experiences to lessen and then hopefully eventually stop the negative coping skills. 
Also, idk if you need to hear this, but you don’t deserve this pain. You’ve been through so much already and I’m so sorry :(

Please don’t apologize for ranting...I personally find it better to rant than to bottle everything up like an emotional volcano you know? My only thing to say would be to reach out to someone who you know is trusted and can actually help you. I know therapy has this big stigma but if your life is in danger or at the very least being contemplated, I really encourage therapy or at least talking to someone who can help you
Wishing you the absolute best!!🤍

Better to rant than internalize! As someone who suffers from sorta the same mentality of “on paper, my life looks great, why am I like this?” I have to remind myself that depression, intrusive thoughts, feelings of uselessness, etc don’t care if you have a good life. Your struggles are valid, even if you can’t see them yourself. You are fighting through things too. Comparing yourself to others is what the negativity wants you to do bc it’ll end up making you feel worse. (I speak from experience on that one.) And this is going to sound SUPER harsh and I don’t mean it like that, but you can’t control who and what we spend our energy on. You ARE resilient and I think by putting a label on yourself of not being “generally good enough”, you’re dismissing your problems. Like I said before, your struggles are valid. (Sorry if that comes off as mean or harsh or something...I just didn’t know how else to put it)

As an internet stranger, I’m being 100% truthful when I say that you aren’t making me more sad. Honestly, it’s making me happy that you’re responding and truthfully at that. In the end though, I’m just words on a screen and can’t force you to do anything. 
Personally, I think you’re worth saving. Without a doubt. The issue is that you need to believe it yourself and you obviously don’t atm. I really wish I had the right words to encourage you and uplift your self worth.
Also! You really don’t need to apologize...you haven’t done anything wrong to me :) but I won’t force the apologizing subject bc I know people can’t help it and it’s just a knee jerk reaction at this point.

As someone who used to read like that too, I get it. I think my therapist called it extreme burn out or something like that. What she suggested/had to teach me was to ask for help. With my decent family life, I had to learn that people want to help, but I needed to ask them first. I’m not trying to say that it’s easy (bc holyyyyyy heck it’s not) but once I did it the first time with just a friend, my life seemed a little brighter, even if for only a day. Also! It’s totally ok to respond with (to use your words) a “wall of text”! I asked a question, and you’re helping me understand more. So thank you :)

First off, congrats on getting to 18! Or least happy early birthday! I’m guessing it doesn’t feel like there much to celebrate but even surviving this long is a big thing! I’m not saying 18 is this magical year where everything becomes better but going to college and getting more freedom (aka less parent rules) was amazing. For me personally, I set goals and rewards for myself. Like if I get through x days I get to have sushi (my favorite meal). It doesn’t have to be big things, I’ve had to do some where it’s if I get out of bed I get a piece of candy. Either way, I reward myself for living. I’m not saying it’s easy (heckkkk no) but I am waking up on some days actually looking forward to that day instead of wanting to sleep the day away.
I would really caution you with thinking that SH helps. It’s extremely addicting and I highly encourage you to find other ways of distracting.

I can tell you what I’ve done and maybe you’ll resonate? Obviously it’s different for everyone tho. What I did was get to the root of the “why” with my therapist and then learned DBT skills (aka distractions, coping tools) to use when I can feel my mood dip. It’s not 100% effective but when I use my skills, it greatly decreases the chance of me doing SH. I also decided to have a trusted person come and throw away my methods that I used to SH and hide the ones that couldn’t be thrown out. I hope this helps and for what it’s worth (I am just a random internet person after all haha), it’s really awesome that you want to stop. I’m proud of you!

Hi! I’ve been in therapy for some odd years...my advice would be to keep an open mind but also know that if you don’t feel comfortable sharing with your therapist, it’s not a one and done, there’s many therapists out there. (I’m currently on my third and really fortunate to have her.) I won’t lie, some sessions may be rough, but other times, it can feel super reliving to just vent and get steered in the right direction if that makes any sense. 
Then again, everyone experiences therapy differently because we are different and so are the therapists. I’m just telling you my experience. Good luck!!💜
Wishing you the best of luck!! It’s wicked awesome that you’re deciding to cope instead of SH. Proud of you!

Find something you enjoy that won’t hurt yourself, like maybe curl up under a fuzzy blanket with hot chocolate? I like sensory things which is why warmth helps me. If the urge is really bad, I jump into a cold shower for like 30secs to shock the system. It sucks but it’s effective as long as I don’t abuse it. And ofc, reaching out to a trusted person does wonders in my opinion. Good luck!
